senses.gloss: m. (טְרִי) dripping; מֵי ט׳ a sort of ink, prob. from wine-lees (v. Löw Graph. Requisiten, p. 158, p. 161).
units: <cite ref="Gittin 19a:14">Gitt. 19ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 104b:4">Sabb. 104ᵇ</cite> (early eds. <cite ref="M01134"><he>מיטריא</he></cite> in one w.; Rashi: ‘juice of a certain fruit’, oth. opin. ‘rain water’).
